plugins/mqttbe/desktop/js/mqttbe.js.Nom que l\\'appareil annonce lui-même: Name the device announces for itself
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/js/mqttbe.js.Une adresse publique ne change pas : l\\: A public address does not change: the device created will stay valid.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/js/mqttbe.js.Cette adresse est renouvelée toutes les: This address is renewed about every fifteen minutes — that is how a phone protects itself from tracking. The device created would go silent at the next change: this is rarely a good candidate.

plugins/mqttbe/desktop/modal/adoption.ph.Ces appareils se sont annoncés sur le br: These devices announced themselves on the broker and nothing was created for them: this is not a failure, it is a question.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/modal/adoption.ph.La découverte reconnaît ce qu'elle sait: Discovery recognizes what it knows how to recognize; the rest it sets aside rather than deciding in your place. A Bluetooth gateway sees a visitor's phone go by, the neighbor's watch and the tracker hanging on your keys: only you know which ones deserve a device.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/modal/adoption.ph.Une adresse Bluetooth aléatoire (random): A random Bluetooth address is changed by the device about every fifteen minutes: that is the mark of a phone or a watch passing by, and the device created would go silent at the next change. A public address does not move: it is the address of a beacon or a sensor, and it deserves a device.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/modal/adoption.ph.La durée de présence dit le reste : un o: How long it has been seen says the rest: something that belongs to the house has been there for days, a passer-by for two minutes.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/modal/adoption.ph.La file se remplit au fil des annonces :: The queue fills up as the announcements come in: whatever is missing here has not said anything yet.
No device is waiting for a decision.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/modal/adoption.ph.Tout ce que la découverte a reconnu a ét: Everything discovery recognized has been created, and nothing unknown has announced itself since the daemon started. A device that has been connected for a long time no longer announces itself: the "Rescan devices" button in the plugin configuration asks it to introduce itself again.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/modal/adoption.ph.Écarter n'est pas définitif : remis dans: Ignoring is not final: put back in the loop, the device shows up in the queue again at its next announcement — right away if it keeps talking, after a rescan if it has gone quiet.

plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Ouvrez la configuration du plugin et sai: Open the plugin configuration and enter the address of your MQTT broker: it is the only setting needed to get started.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.La découverte automatique est désactivée: Automatic discovery is turned off: devices announcing themselves on the broker no longer create anything, only the commands entered by hand keep being listened to.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.La découverte reconnaît les appareils ma: Discovery recognizes the devices but creates none: automatic creation is turned off.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.La découverte écoute : un appareil qui s: Discovery is listening: a device that announces itself shows up here on its own. A device that has been connected for a long time, though, no longer announces itself — ask it to introduce itself with the "Rescan devices" button in the plugin configuration.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Pour créer un équipement à la main :: To create a device by hand:
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Cliquez sur « Ajouter un équipement » et: Click "Add a device" and give it a name.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Indiquez son topic de base, par exemple: Enter its base topic, for example shellies/shelly1pm-A8B0C1000105: it is used to prefill the topic of the commands.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Dans l\\'onglet « Commandes », ajoutez u: In the "Commands" tab, add an info command to read a value, or an action command to publish a message, then save.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Équipement créé à la main : la découvert: Device created manually: discovery does not touch it
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Le préfixe commun aux topics de cet équi: The prefix shared by all the topics of this device. It is used to prefill the topic of the commands you add: it is each command's own topic, and nothing else, that decides what is listened to or published.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Date de la dernière valeur reçue sur une: Date of the last value received on a command of this device.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Identité du périphérique telle que la dé: Identity of the device as discovery recognized it. It does not change when the device gets another IP address: it is what keeps duplicates away.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Cet équipement a été créé par la découve: This device was created by discovery, and it stays yours: rename its commands, fix a unit, hide what you do not need. The next discovery only updates the plumbing — the topic listened to and the path inside the payload — and leaves your changes in place.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Identité du périphérique telle que la dé: Identity of the device as discovery recognized it.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Rien n'est écouté tant qu'aucune command: Nothing is listened to as long as no info command carries a topic: it is the list of commands that decides the daemon's subscriptions.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Une information lit un topic, une action: An info command reads a topic, an action command publishes to a topic.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Pour une information, indiquez le topic: For an info command, enter the topic to listen to; if its payload is JSON, the path says which value to extract from it — for example
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Laissez le chemin vide pour prendre la c: Leave the path empty to take the payload as it is. For an action, enter the topic and the message to publish.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Les réglages fins — correspondance, éche: The advanced settings — value map, scale, rounding, repeat — are folded behind the "Advanced settings" button of each info row: the common case, one topic and one value, does not need them.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Ouvrir la page de l\\'appareil dans un n: Open the device's own page in a new tab: the surest way to tell which one it is
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Telle que l'appareil l'a annoncée. Ouvre: As announced by the device itself. Open it to see which device this is, then rename it here.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.La découverte reconnaît les appareils ma: Discovery recognizes the devices but creates none: automatic creation is turned off. What it sees goes into the adoption queue, and you decide device by device.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.Ouvrir la liste et décider appareil par: Open the list and decide device by device
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.la découverte ne sait pas ce qu\\'ils so: discovery does not know what they are and is waiting for your decision: a beacon of the house deserves a device, a visitor's phone does not.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.appareil(s) écarté(s) — revenir sur un r: device(s) ignored — go back on a refusal
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.La création à la main reste le moyen de: Creating a device by hand remains the way to handle what discovery cannot recognize yet: for now it knows Shelly Gen1 devices and OpenMQTTGateway gateways.
plugins/mqttbe/desktop/php/mqttbe.php.La découverte est arrêtée : la liste ne: Discovery is stopped: the list will not grow any further, but these devices can still be created or ignored.

plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.1883 en clair, 8883 en TLS. Ce sont les: 1883 in the clear, 8883 over TLS. These are the customary ports, not a requirement.
IP address or host name of the MQTT broker. This is the only setting you really need.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Chemin d'un fichier CA sur la machine Je: Path to a CA file on the Jeedom machine, needed if the broker certificate is not signed by a public authority. Left empty, the system authorities apply.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Cochée, un appareil reconnu devient un é: Checked, a recognized device becomes a Jeedom device without asking. Unchecked, it is only reported on the plugin page and nothing is created: time enough to see what discovery finds before letting it act.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Découverte relancée : les appareils se p: Rescan started: the devices are introducing themselves, wait a few seconds.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.La demande passe par le démon et emprunt: The request goes through the daemon and uses the saved settings: if you have just turned discovery back on, save first.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Le chiffrement reste actif, mais l'ident: Encryption stays on, but the broker identity is no longer checked: any server can then impersonate it. Keep this for the self-signed certificate of a home broker.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Le nom que vous avez donné à l'appareil: The name you gave the device in its own app is appended to the technical name: “Shelly 1 55670C boiler” rather than “Shelly 1 55670C”. This requires one request to the device; untick it if you would rather Jeedom did not reach out on your network. If it fails the technical name stays, and a name you have corrected is never replaced. The name is only re-read once a day: to see the effect straight away after ticking this box, save and then use “Rescan devices”.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Le plugin écoute les annonces des appare: The plugin listens to the announcements of the devices present on the broker and works out their devices, their commands and their units. Unchecked, nothing is recognized any more: only the commands entered by hand keep being listened to.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Lire le nom dans l'appareil: Read the name from the device
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.MQTT transmet le mot de passe en clair h: MQTT sends the password in the clear without TLS: on a shared network, turn on encryption below.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Pensez à changer le port : un broker en: Remember to change the port: a TLS broker rarely listens on 1883.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Port local, écouté sur la boucle locale: Local port, bound to the loopback only, through which Jeedom passes its orders to the daemon. Change it only if that port is already taken on this machine.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Redemande à tout le parc de se présenter: Asks every device to introduce itself again: a device that has been connected for weeks no longer announces itself, and would stay invisible although it keeps publishing its values. This is the button to use after installing the plugin on an installation already in service.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Silence toléré par le broker avant qu'il: How long the broker tolerates silence before declaring the connection dead. The daemon sends it a sign of life within that delay.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Un motif par ligne, avec les jokers MQTT: One pattern per line, with the MQTT wildcards + and #. What Jeedom publishes itself is listed by default: taking it back in would mean discovering its own devices.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Vos retouches survivent à la relance : u: Your changes survive a rescan: a renamed command, a corrected unit or a hidden display are never overwritten. Discovery only updates the plumbing — the topic listened to and the path inside the payload.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.À laisser vide si le broker accepte les: Leave empty if the broker accepts anonymous connections.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Décochée, seules les balises que la pass: Unticked, only the beacons the gateway can decode — a thermometer, a recognized tracker — become devices; the rest wait for your decision. Ticked, everything that goes by becomes a device, visitors' phones included: on a gateway near a doorway, that quickly means dozens of devices a day.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Silence au bout duquel une balise Blueto: How long a Bluetooth beacon may stay silent before it is declared away. This is the very definition of your trackers' presence: too short and an object left in a drawer will flicker between present and away; too long and you will learn late that it has gone. A tracker does not broadcast continuously, hence the five-minute default.
plugins/mqttbe/plugin_info/configuration.Au-delà de ce nombre, la découverte cess: Past this number, discovery stops creating and holds the following devices for your decision. Discovery works from what flows on the broker, and nothing compels what flows there to be honest. 0 removes the ceiling.
